Dear Valuable guests, We are delighted to announce the upcoming introduction of our newly renovated luxury guest rooms, located on the 3rd, 4th, and 5th floors of Pullman Hanoi. Elegantly designed with a contemporary aesthetic, our newly renovated rooms seamlessly blend modern luxury with exceptional comfort. Inspired by the rich culture and charm of Hanoi, subtle local touches have been thoughtfully woven into every detail, creating a warm and inviting retreat where you can relax, recharge, and enjoy an even more memorable stay. As we complete the final stages of this enhancement project, you may experience some minor noise or temporary inconvenience during your stay. We sincerely apologize for any disruption this may cause and greatly appreciate your patience. Thank you for your continued trust and support. We look forward to welcoming you to Pullman Hanoi soon Best regards, Hotel management team Premium superior room Refresh and recharge in this fully renovated Premium Superior Room, where contemporary Hanoi design meets modern comfort.
